assumptions: The threshold given is the real acceptance criterion.
limits: Compares one value; a table needs check_rows.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Compares a value with a threshold and stops the run; the science is in whatever produced the value.
bio.jane/contract.question: Does this value meet its threshold, and should the pipeline continue?

description: A QC gate. Compares a wired value against a threshold and PASSES or FAILS the pipeline there — every node downstream of a failed gate is skipped, so a run stops at the first check that does not hold. This is how a pipeline expresses 'only continue if the clone is right'.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

against.description: optional: compare against another step's value instead of the fixed threshold. When wired, this wins over `threshold`. Only applies when operator is == or != or > or >= or < or <=.

against_factor.description: multiply the compared-against value by this first, so `at least twice the smallest band` is one gate rather than an arithmetic step. Only applies when operator is == or != or > or >= or < or <=.

against_offset.description: then add this, so `within 50 bp of the predicted size` is expressible against a computed value. Only applies when operator is == or != or > or >= or < or <=.

label.description: what this gate is checking, in your words — it becomes the message when the gate fails (e.g. 'single EcoRI site').

max.description: upper bound, inclusive. Only applies when operator is between.

min.description: lower bound, inclusive. Only applies when operator is between.

operator.description: how to compare. Values: == (equals), != (does not equal), > (greater than), >= (at least), < (less than), <= (at most), between (between (inclusive)), in (is one of), not_in (is none of), contains (contains text), is_true (is true), not_empty (is not empty).

record.description: optional: the record this gate is guarding. It comes straight back out of the `record` output when the check passes, so the gate sits in the middle of a chain.

report_only.description: report the verdict instead of stopping the run: wire `passed` (or `failed`) into another step's condition to choose a branch.

set.description: the values the checked value must be one of (or none of), compared as text, so `1` matches 1. Only applies when operator is in or not_in.

text.description: the text the value must contain. Only applies when operator is contains.

threshold.description: the value to compare against. Leave it unset and wire `against` instead to compare two steps. Only applies when operator is == or != or > or >= or < or <=.

value.description: the value to check — wire a number (cut count, product size, tip count, Tm) or any output; a list is compared by its length.

name: check_value

failed.description: the opposite verdict, so the ELSE arm of a branch needs no extra step. Only meaningful with `report_only` on

passed.description: whether the check held. As a gate this is true whenever it is read downstream, since a failure stops the run; with `report_only` on it is the real verdict, for driving a branch

record.description: the guarded record, unchanged — wire it into the next node's $subject to make that step conditional on this check

value.description: the value that was checked, passed straight through so the gate can sit mid-chain
